parsed.explanation: The dossier shows no trans-specific criminal offence, no documented police targeting, no facility or document rule, and no trans-specific violence. The former same-sex conduct offences (a secondary, sexuality-law factor) were repealed in 2023 and were never enforced in living memory; the amending bill explicitly cited growing LGBT acceptance, and an active LGBTI organisation litigates before parliament — documented acceptance plus functioning institutions. Marriage non-recognition is a real but modest visitor-facing negative (no spousal standing, foreign marriage unrecognized). Remaining gaps (border document treatment, ward/custody placement, service discrimination) are open questions, not exposures, and thin data here sits in a well-governed, reforming setting, so extrapolation is mildly positive rather than toward risk. Friction would likely be curiosity-level; no tier-1 or tier-2 feature is documented.
